title: REA Slotted Report Serialization & MemGraphRAG Partition Propagation Invariant

edges.description: MemGraphRAGService save_dir partition propagation in retrieve, query, and add_passage
Zero-allocation TFLite, HDF5, SavedModel PB, and TF.js shard header parsers

claims.assertion: Slotted, frozen report dataclasses inheriting from ReaManagedReportBase must expose .to_dict() and .model_dump() via dataclasses.asdict(self) so ReaDomainAdapter.call_managed does not fall back to an empty dict {} and falsely report available managed/model facets as unknown.

StandardReaToolkitService.detect_artifact and ModelArtifactEngine.inspect_model must recognize TFLite FlatBuffers (TFL3 magic at offset 4), Keras/HDF5 superblocks (\x89HDF\r\n\x1a\n), TensorFlow SavedModel Protobufs (saved_model.pb), and TensorFlow.js weight shards (*shard*.bin + sibling model.json) under ai_model prior to generic firmware fallback.

MemGraphRAGService.retrieve(), query(), and add_passage() must accept and forward save_dir: str = 'outputs/default' so callers indexing into custom graph partitions do not silently query the default partition.

author: Brain Harness Reflector (harness-reflector)
